notes.title: Asteroid Force Build Update
notes.content:
Bugs Fix
- Waves complete hardcoded to value of 99. Leaderboard for waves complete will now reflect the correct number of waves completed.

Upcoming:
- New build that will support MacOS. Coming soon...

Remember to leave feedback when playing the game. The game is still in early access as more development is done. The more feedback received the better the game can become.

Happy Gaming!!
